verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a graphics card, and setting up autonomous background automations is a software or agent-platform capability outside a GPU's product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the card or its first-party software shipping user-configurable autonomous automations: CUDA tooling and AI acceleration are developer building blocks, and NVIDIA app game updates are a different feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
